2607.23082.title: Scoping Review of AI, Metrology, and ESG in the Semiconductor Sector: Implications for Safe and Sustainable by Design (SSbD)
2607.23082.paper_summary: The semiconductor sector faces a dual transition: scaling manufacturing execution through Artificial Intelligence (AI) while satisfying stringent sustainability mandates, such as the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM). This paper presents a scoping review of 1,465 documents indexed in Web of Science and Scopus, spanning AI-integrated metrology, supply chain ESG, and federated industrial data spaces. Network analysis reveals a highly fragmented "core-periphery" knowledge structure, emphasizing a critical structural hole between AI-driven process optimization and downstream sustainability governance. To close these gaps, this study proposes a 6-layer Safe and Sustainable by Design (SSbD) architecture grounded in a System of Systems (SoS) paradigm. By establishing distinct "grid-to-core" and "standards-through-supply-chain" integration pathways, the proposed framework demonstrates how virtual metrology (VM), localized federated learning, and defensive RegTech mechanisms can build provenance-aware data fabrics. Ultimately, this architecture positions regulatory compliance as a driver for innovation, enabling secure, climate-neutral, and circular value chains in semiconductor manufacturing.
2607.23082.paper_summary_zh: 半導體行業面臨雙重轉型：通過人工智慧（AI）擴大製造執行，同時滿足嚴格的可持續性要求，例如歐盟碳邊界調整機制（CBAM）。本文對在Web of Science和Scopus中索引的1,465篇文獻進行了範疇回顧，涵蓋了AI整合的計量學、供應鏈ESG和聯邦工業數據空間。網絡分析揭示了一個高度碎片化的“核心-邊緣”知識結構，強調了AI驅動的過程優化與下游可持續性治理之間的關鍵結構性缺口。為了填補這些空白，本研究提出了一個基於系統之系統（SoS）範式的6層安全與可持續設計（SSbD）架構。通過建立明確的“網格到核心”和“標準通過供應鏈”的整合路徑，所提出的框架展示了虛擬計量（VM）、本地化聯邦學習和防禦性RegTech機制如何構建具有來源意識的數據結構。最終，這一架構將合規性定位為創新的驅動力，使半導體製造中的安全、氣候中立和循環價值鏈成為可能。
